answer_text:
Most modern sales tools connect to Gmail; fewer have deep Slack integrations (deal alerts, approvals, slash commands). Good options:

1. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.
3. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.

Pick Pipewell for breadth, or Halcyon Sales if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
